name: HOL Guard
tagline: Open-source security layer that makes AI coding agents stop for approval before risky actions
description: HOL Guard is an open-source security layer for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. It checks risky actions before they run, including secret and credential reads, risky shell commands, MCP server changes and package installs, and stops them or asks for approval while ordinary work stays quiet. Our public benchmark page lists the 308 core scenarios and the exact pass rules: https://hol.org/guard/research/ai-coding-agent-runtime-security-benchmark
